evidence: Structure is graded, not binary: gates are two binary basic-reachability/shared-persistence checks (tests/gates/render/judge.toml:20-34, constraints/judge.toml:20-37) at weight 0.0 (tests/scoring.toml:1-3); shaped reward functional 0.6/polish 0.2/visual 0.2 (scoring.toml:5-8) via weighted_mean over 16 binary functional criteria with weights 1.5-4.0 summing to 42 (functional/judge.toml:29-36, criteria 39-280), 6 binary polish criteria (polish/judge.toml:17-72) and 4 anchored 0-5 likert visual criteria (visual/judge.toml:20-82); score.py computes reward=round(weighted,4) when gates pass and functional>0.05 (score.py:41-48). Functional prompt is individual-mode and both scored prompts require independent per-criterion scoring (functional/prompt.md:59-61; polish/prompt.md:20-26); the only all-or-nothing rule in scored suites is the global browser gate (sign-in + real server data), which a partial-quality app passes. Measured spread exists only on the PREVIOUS v2 bytes: hosted Oracle 0.9917, nop 0, openhands/GPT-5.6 0.8114 with functional 0.7273 = 12/16 criteria passing (luna-scored-details.json: failed signin_and_client_scope, wall_mentions_and_links, unread_and_new_messages_line, search_and_transcript), polish 1.0, visual 0.875 with likert 0.75 values - a real graded spread, file hashes match the index. Weak-app reasoning on current bytes: an app with no transcript page still keeps ~16/42 functional mass; no search keeps ~15/42; missing both still scores ~12/42 (wall_mentions_and_links, wall_added_live, nested_replies, message_links, unread, live_updates) plus polish/visual credit, so no single precondition collapses the reward to 0/1. Risks (not defects for this row): (a) search and transcript are cross-cutting legs/positive controls in 8-9 functional criteria (~26-27/42 mass each), compressing scores for an app with one broken surface; (b) shared-DB ordering can cascade, e.g. a failed wall lift in wall_added_live step 4 leaves Sian walled from M-13, which fails Sian's positive controls in timer_changes step 5 and edits_and_stale_edit step 3 (~9/42 from one defect); (c) functional floor 0.05 x 42 = 2.1 means an app passing only one 1.5/2.0 criterion gets reward 0 despite polish/visual credit (small cliff); (d) a scored-suite timeout (11100 s, test.sh run_suite) yields reward 0 since score.py then has no scored data. Required evidence missing: raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'reward discrimination/ranking on these bytes and Oracle/target scores for these bytes are absent'; v3 changed five functional criteria and three polish rows, so the v2 spread is indicative only. Hence risk=true until a hash-bound discrimination run (golden + mutated weak apps or a hosted model run) on these bytes exists.
